content: Pita yuuh Jon daale kaansol-aso mend

+ o 4:1 Luk 22:4,52*Ngaaho lak in taaku naambus na tombe Pita yuuh Jon daahen mondanêêl vakasin vu hil, tonde kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato laving yêêv sen nanggin Anutu-te dumb bop-ato osin hil Sadusi lala lalup vu yuuh.
+ o 4:2 Sin 23:8*Hil-anju ahend kalin vu yuuh in nambe yuuh davu taahu hil osin yuuh danêêl vakasin sen Yesu kandi lak laah om hil yimbin pin e kandi jak naah-ato,
+ o 4:3 Sin 5:18*tombe lalôôh yuuh-ambe lala laayiiy vinavi in yuuh in nambe yuuh mando be samiinaanôôn e mem.
+ o 4:4 Sin 2:41; 5:14*Lemu hil sen lango Pita-te vakasin-ambe lawii-having-ato, ond hil-anju moow ngeeyaata lôôt lohvu 5 taosen.
Samiinaanôôn atombe silate yêêv bop-aso laving himbop-aso de tanasin dangga-so be lasupin vu Yelusalem,
ond sil lasupin having kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv bop Anas, de Kaiapas ayuuh Jon, de Aleksanda, tonde yêêv bop Anas-ate hil pin.
+ o 4:7 Mat 21:23*Tombe lalaah sinaale yuuh-anjuuto daale sil amend, le mem lalingin yuuh nambe, “Muuh nawiing vaa-jo lak lati-te niwêêk osin haale?”
+ o 4:8 Mat 10:19-20; Sin 7:55*Tombe Vavi Vaambuung hôôvu Pita, om nêêl vu sil nambe, “Ham sen ham atu hil-ate yêêv bop-ato osin himbop-aso pin,
gêên-anjo haay samu vakasin vu ham in samu samu sen haay aawiing vaha paaya ti nivasa hôôk-ato, de haay tatekin danggakook vu ham.

+ o 4:10 Sin 3:6,13-16*Om nambêênja ham pin-ande Islel pin, ond ham oo anjak ni naambe omaahôô-jo nivasa lak-ambe gêên naale hôôk ham amem lak Yesu Kalisi Nasaalet haale, sen ham ayiis ak haah pako, lemu Anutu wiing-ambe kandi lak laah vu hil yimbin-atêêto.
+ o 4:11 Saam 118:22; Mat 21:42; 1Pi 2:4,7*Ond Yesuu-ju ‘tatuuh sen ham hil kul-aso yoo nimbaya lôôt nambe ham-ame andaav bayêên ak-ato, lemu gêên tu bayêên ahelasu-te kook aniwêêk.’
+ o 4:12 Mat 1:21; Sin 5:34-35*Omaaho ti me-lukalaah nambe dôôvu yiiy e, de vu taaku pin ond Anutu me-taato omaaho ti haale vu yiiy nambêênja in nambe dôôvu yiiy e, yik Yesu timu.”

Tombe kaansol-aso lavindis lôôt in Pita yuuh Jon danêêl tanasin osin niwêêk de yuuh-ame dayêênin e, tombe lalak ni nambe yuuh-ame vu hil tanasin-ate le, yuuh vu hil malis-ate, lemu lalak ni having nambe bôôy yuuh dando having Yesu.
Tombe layi de omaaho vaha paayaa-to nivasa lak lung la be naale having yuuh, om silanêênd vakasin sen daanêêl naah vu yuuh-ato ma.
Yik lanêêl vu yuuh amu nambe yuuh gavuuh kaansol-aso de lana voon, om yuuh lala de sil oo mondakaas in nambe,
+ o 4:16 Jon 11:47*“Yale aambiing naambe vaati vu omaaho yuuh-anju? In hil Yelusalem pin layi nambe yuuh lawiing taahu taahu bopaata osin niwêêk tii-ju, om yame aalohvu nambe yanjak alungg in e.
+ o 4:17-19 Sin 5:28-29,40*Lemu vakasin-anjo le na nohvu hil pin, om yaambu kôôvu yuuh naambe yuuh-ame daanêêl vakasin vu omaaho ti jak Yesu haale jesin naah e.”
Tombe lateey yuuh lalom-ambe lavu kôôvu yuuh nambe yuuh-ame daanêêl Yesu haale osin yuuh-ame taahu hil jak Yesu haale jesin naah e.
Le Pita yuuh Jon lanêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Ham akam oo bu vêêl e, naambe haay gangoyin ham lavam ond haay nanyengg doos vu Anutu, tombe naambêênjo Anutu me-le ji nivasa le.
Va sen haay aahe osin haay hango ond me-lohvu nambe haay anjak alungg in e, haay oo aawiingin nambe naanêêl vakasin-anjo lôôt.”
Tombe kaansol-aso salo mopaatôôv in nambe lambu nivaane vu yuuh, lemu layi de hil pin lako Anutu haale lak in va sen yuuh lawiing-ato, om lavu kôôvu yuuh yesin laah, de lanêêl-ambe yuuh lala.
De omaaho sen yuuh lawiing-ambe nivasa lak-ato ond yite ta doo-yuuh lung la.
Kalisi-te hil lalohak in nambe daanêêl Anutu-te vakasin niwêêk
Pita yuuh Jon lalaah lato vu yuuhate hil, tombe yuuh lanêêl vakasin pin sen kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin himbop-aso lanêêl vu yuuh-ato vu sil.

+ o 4:24 Eks 20:11; Nie 9:6; Saam 146:6*Tombe sil lango lung la, tonde sil pin alondpayo lavuh ti be lalohak vu Anutu nambe, “O Omaaho Bop, hong sen ohatung yendak osin ngaanggis, de lôôy osin va pin sen nando lohvu taaku pin-ato,
+ o 4:25-26 Saam 2:1-2*de gate Vavi Vaambuung wiing vakasin ti la vu heyate himbop bôôy Devit sen tu gate kul vahaa-to, ond Vavi Vaambuung nêêl nambe,

content.text: ‘Nambe vaati om hil vaalu sen sil-ame Yudaa-to ond ahend kalin-ambe davu daandun bopaata, de yate hil Islel ond kand navu vakasin malis amu?
De hil lulemak-aso vu taaku pin osin yêêv bop-aso pin lasupin lalaam in nambe lanyiis ngaamong ak Omaaho Bop gaving yite omaaho sen yoo holin yi vulôôt in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato.’

content: + o 4:27 Mat 27:1-2; Luk 23:7-11; Sin 3:13*“Keen lôôt, Helot ayuuh Pontias Pilata laving hil vaalu osin hil Islel ond hil-anjo lasupin lalaam taakuu-jo in nambe lanyiis ngaamong vu gate kul vaha omaaho vaambuung Yesu sen goo gaholin yii-to,
+ o 4:28 Sin 2:23*ond sil lasupin in nambe lanyiis Yesu nohvu goo gakam vu niwêêk-ambe osamu lung la nambe nôôn jak-ato.
+ o 4:29 Ep 6:19*“O Omaaho Bop, gêên-anjo gakam bu vakasin sen lavu kôôvu hey-ato, be gandôôvu gate hil hey in hey naanêêl gate vakasin niwêêk lôôt, de hey-ame aanjêênin e.
Otalo namam in biing-ambe hil anilakin nind vasa jak, de gandôôvu hey in hey aambiing taahu taahu osin niwêêk jak gate kul vaha omaaho vaambuung Yesu haale.”
+ o 4:31 Sin 2:4*Lalohak lung la tonde bayêên sen lasupin-ambe dando hôôk-ato yêêy, tombe Vavi Vaambuung hôôvu sil pin, om sil lanêêl Anutu-te tanasin niwêêk lôôt de me-layêênin e.
Kalisi-te hil pin alondpayo lavuh ti

+ o 4:32 Sin 2:44*Hil ngeeyaata sen lawii-having osin ahend having sil-ato ond londpayo lavuh ti pin, de va sen sil ti ti yoote vaa-to ond ti me-nêêlin yite vati nambe yoo yite va nivalok e, malis, va sen silate vaa-to ond yik sil pin-ate va.
+ o 4:33 Sin 2:47*Anutu vu niwêêk bopaata vu sinaale-so be sil tatekin va sen Omaaho Bop Yesu kandi lak laah-ato langaah lôôt, tombe hil pin layi nambe Anutu-te samu samu bopaata nando having sil.
+ o 4:34 Sin 2:45*Tombe silate omaaho ti me-nativak in vati le, in dangga nambe lavu ngaanggis osin bayêên-ambe hil laanggo, de lako mone be
lala lavu vu sinaale-so, tombe latiiy monêê-jo vu omaahonôôn vaalu sen silanêênd va yuuh ame ma de dativak-ato.
+ o 4:36 Sin 11:22-26; 13:2-3*De Liwi-te hil vu taamusin-ato ti baan Saiplas, haale nambe Yusep, de sinaale-so lanêêl haale ango nambe Banabas, haalêê-jo dangga nambe omaaho sen navu niwêêk,
ond vu yite kul ti vu omaaho ti vaanggo de hako mone pin-ambe la vu vu sinaale-so.
